title: Audit Trail: See Who Changed What and When | Orchard Core
description:
When several people edit a site, it is hard to say who changed a page, when they changed it, and what it said before.

The Audit Trail module records back-end changes as events, each with a category, an event name, the user who caused it and the time. This video enables the module, chooses what to record, makes a change, and reads the log.

In this video:
• Why an audit trail
• Enable the module
• Choose what to record
• Make a change
• Read the log
• Event details
• History of one item
• Good to know: permissions, comments and user events
